findings: learner.overview: Lead with the supported construction and common current meaning: 口 supplies the vocal meaning category and 昌 the sound cue; 唱 means “sing/chant.” Keep “lead or guide” as a reported meaning without implying that it is earliest in a demonstrated chronology. Supported by E2, E3, E7, X-de38e249c4c076324b6f, and X-623155a712d0fd50a244.
